historical_cutoff.rule: completion of final scheduled game of Week 2

methodology.alternate_hr: hits/10 using exact locked Stage 1 L10 observations; Over alternate line hit requires the observation to be strictly greater than the listed line
methodology.bands: Floor = lowest available alternate with HR ≥6/10; Core = highest available alternate with HR ≥6/10; Ceiling = next higher available alternate above Core, regardless of HR
methodology.narrowing_rule: Carry forward only when Core HR ≥7/10 AND at least one available alternate reaches ≥8/10; this narrows the context set without changing Stage 1 qualification
